title: Split View wrapper must inherit playerShell's original flex footprint, not flex:1 1 100%
trigger: A wrapper element replaces a flex item in a flex row that has siblings, and the wrapper uses flex:1 1 100% (or width:100%) — this takes the entire row, collapsing siblings to 0 width
principle: When a wrapper replaces a flex item in a flex row with siblings, the wrapper must inherit the original item's flex footprint (flex-grow, flex-shrink, flex-basis). Using flex:1 1 100% + width:100% makes the wrapper take 100% of the row. If a sibling has flex-basis:0 + flex-grow:1 (e.g. Bootstrap .col-xl without a number), it competes for growing space but loses because the wrapper's basis is 100% — the sibling collapses to 0 width and its content (episode selector, drama info) disappears. If a sibling has a fixed width (flex:0 0 auto), the wrapper shrinks to fill the remaining space — this works by accident but is still wrong. Fix: detect flex-row parents with siblings and use flex:0 0 {originalWidth}px for the wrapper, or better, parse the computed flex-basis percentage for responsive sizing.

cases.context: kisskh: .row (flex row) contains .col-xl-7 (video, flex:0 0 58.33%) + .col-xl (drama info, flex:1 0 0px). Split View wrapper replaces .col-xl-7 with flex:1 1 100% + width:100%. Total flex-basis: 100% + 0 = 100%. Both grow:1, no remaining space. Wrapper = 100% = 1891px, drama col = 0px. Episode selector disappears.

themoviebox: .player-container (flex row) contains .w-full h-[203px] (video, 1226px) + resources panel (409px, flex:0 1 auto). The old flex:1 1 100% worked by accident because the resources panel has a fixed width and flex-shrink:0, so the wrapper shrinks to 1226px. But the fix (flex:0 0 1226px) is explicit and correct.

applyFor: Split View / Player Mode wrappers that replace a flex item in a flex row with siblings
Any DOM reparenting where a wrapper replaces a flex item and must preserve the original layout footprint
Bootstrap/Angular/Tailwind layouts with flex-row containers where one column is wrapped and siblings must remain visible
Wrapper flex-basis selection: use original width when siblings exist, use 1 1 100% when the wrapper should fill the parent
